summary: Feed s147_double to NDR is degraded: VLAN 20 traffic missing (49% untagged) and 7.0% TCP packet loss detected. NDR has blind spot for VLAN 20 and incomplete flows due to drops.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or TAP/SPAN trunk is stripping or not forwarding 802.1Q tags for VLAN 20. Required VLAN 20 not seen and 49% of packets are untagged, indicating VLAN preservation is disabled or trunk allowed-list missing VLAN 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR is blind to all traffic on VLAN 20 and cannot apply VLAN-aware policies; 49% untagged traffic loses segmentation context, reducing detection coverage for lateral movement and VLAN-hopping.

recommended_fix.why: Enable VLAN tag preservation/pass-through for required VLANs 10 and 20 on broker ingress/egress and verify trunk allows VLAN 20 so NDR receives correctly tagged traffic.

findings.root_cause: Visibility path is dropping packets before the NDR - 171 of 2435 TCP packets (7.0%) show gaps/retransmissions exceeding 1% threshold. Tool overload check is healthy, so drops are upstream on SPAN/broker egress buffers due to microbursts or oversubscription, not tool NIC overload.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR with needs_full_payload and needs_both_directions cannot reassemble flows or extract payloads; 7% missing segments causes broken TCP reassembly, missed detections, and false negatives for IDS/NDR analytics.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute feed across additional NDR tool ports / broker egress group with 5-tuple hashing to eliminate egress buffer drops and ensure complete flow delivery without reordering.
